chapterTitle: Federal Board Annual Exam Simulator 07 (Full Book Simulator - Lecturer Jazab)
subject: math-10

questions.question: The circumference of a circle is called its:
questions.explanation: The total boundary line enclosing the circular area is its circumference.

questions.question: A line intersecting a circle at two points is called a:
questions.explanation: A line passing through a circle and cutting it at two points is a secant line.

questions.question: The portion of a circle enclosed between two radii and an arc is called a:
questions.explanation: A region bounded by two radii and the intercepted arc is a sector.

questions.question: Circles having three non-collinear points in common must:
questions.explanation: Since three non-collinear points determine a unique circle, any circles sharing them must coincide.

questions.question: A 4 cm long chord subtends a central angle of 60°. The radial segment of this circle is:
questions.explanation: The central triangle is equilateral, so radius = chord length = 4 cm.

questions.question: The length of a chord and radial segment are congruent. The central angle made by the chord is:
questions.explanation: All three sides are equal (r, r, r), giving central angle = 60°.

questions.question: Out of two congruent arcs, if one arc makes a central angle of 30°, the other arc will subtend:
questions.explanation: Congruent arcs in a circle always subtend equal central angles.

questions.question: An arc subtends a central angle of 40°. Then the corresponding chord will subtend a central angle of:
questions.explanation: The chord and arc share endpoints, both subtending 40° at the centre.

questions.question: A pair of chords of a circle subtending two congruent central angles are:
questions.explanation: Equal central angles intercept congruent chords.

questions.question: The measure of central angle of a minor arc is:

options.A: Double the angle subtended by corresponding major arc

questions.question: The angle in a semicircle is a:
questions.explanation: An inscribed angle in a semicircle is 90°.

questions.question: The opposite angles of any cyclic quadrilateral are:
questions.explanation: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral sum to 180°.

questions.question: The angle in a segment greater than a semicircle is:
questions.explanation: Inscribed angle in a major segment is acute.

questions.question: The angle in a segment less than a semicircle is:
questions.explanation: Inscribed angle in a minor segment is obtuse.

questions.question: The centre of an incircle of a triangle is the concurrency point of the:
questions.explanation: Internal angle bisectors meet at the incentre.
